mentions.name: Chartrow
mentions.description: A website for visualizing stock market data. Features include a periodic-table view of relative performance (e.g. QQQ outperformance), charts of stocks that are cheap relative to their own multiples over the past 10 years, a stock screener that shows histograms, and lists such as stocks with high shareholder yield (dividend yield plus buyback yield).
